policy: Every Compatibility Layer / Transitional Layer in the codebase must have a real Exit Strategy recorded here before it ships (owner, 2026-08-05) — no iframe embed, shim, or bridge is allowed to exist without one. removal_condition_met stays false until the owner has actually verified the Removal Condition true (Runtime + Registry + End-to-End all real-checked, never inferred) — scripts/check-transitional-layers.ts only proposes removal for entries where this is already true; it never flips it itself. Different from registry/capability-roadmap.json (feature progress) — this is specifically the removal contract for temporary bridges.

layers.temporary_reason: อยู่ระหว่างย้ายเข้าสู่ Native Runtime — Dev Loop Pipeline ยังเป็นหน้าเว็บแยก (app/admin/dev-loop/DevLoopDashboard.tsx) ไม่ได้ fetch/render อยู่ในเชลล์โดยตรง
layers.replacement_target: Native Runtime Panel — RuntimeSidebar's tool renders evidence/checks/proposals/watcher-status directly via app/api/admin/workspace/* pattern, kind: "json" tab, no iframe
layers.removal_condition: Native Panel ผ่าน Runtime, Registry และ End-to-End ครบ (Owner login เข้าจริง เห็นข้อมูล evidence/checks/proposals/watcher-status ถูกต้อง)
layers.blocking_dependency: Runtime Panel ยังไม่เสร็จ — DevLoopDashboard.tsx's realtime Supabase queries + approve/reject flow ยังไม่ได้เขียนใหม่เป็น native tab
layers.estimated_removal: TBD — no date committed, blocked on Wave 5 scheduling
